title: Sum of two dice
statement:
Two fair dice are rolled. What is the probability that the total is **[$s.s]**?

[______]{a}

feedback.message: The 11 totals 2–12 are not equally likely. Count ordered pairs (first die, second die) out of 36.

hints: There are 6 × 6 = 36 equally likely ordered pairs (die 1, die 2).
List the pairs that add to [$s.s]; (1, 2) and (2, 1) are different pairs.
solution: The pairs that add to [$s.s] are [$s.pairs]: [$s.k] of the 36 equally likely pairs, so $P = [$s.k]/36$.
